title: hydrangea aspera subsp. sargentiana
intro: Hydrangea aspera subsp. sargentiana, commonly known as the Sargent's Hydrangea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Hydrangeaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sargent's Hydrangea include pain relief, reducing fever, and treating various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
